defect: Boolean OR replaces bitwise status merge
rationale: The nonzero lane masks collapse to a single truth bit. For overflow_i=4'b1000 and underflow_i=0 the output becomes 0001 instead of preserving lane 3.
author: gpt-6.1-sol

labels.note: Logical OR produces one Boolean bit instead of the per-bit vector combination implied by the status interface.
